_comment: Reviewed corrections to the census table's places (#159, plan v2 MF2). `fixes` set a field zip's city where the land-area rule picks the wrong place; `aliases` name the census place of a club or event city whose census name differs (consolidated governments). Every placeGeoid must exist in public/data/zip-places.json with that placeName and state; a fix the area rule already gives is redundant. A bad entry is left out, reported, and fails `python archive.py --search-index --check`. Each entry carries its evidence.

fixes.evidence: Surf Sports Park (complexes at 92014) is at the Del Mar Fairgrounds, in the City of Del Mar; the 2022-23 Playoffs (event 2719) were held there, listed at "Del Mar, CA". Owner decision D2 and PR 1's P02/P08 treat it as Del Mar, nearby for San Diego. In the census table the land-area rule gives 92014 to San Diego (0666000), because the zip also covers a larger part of the City of San Diego; Del Mar (0618506) is the census place of that name in San Diego County.

aliases.evidence: TGS lists club 56 (Gwinnett Soccer Academy) at "Liburn, GA", a misspelling of Lilburn. Its main home field is at zip 30047 (205 home games in the archive), which the census table gives to the place Lilburn (1346356), Gwinnett County.
